reason: Everything I need already comes through my class WhatsApp groups, and the CR posts it before any official notice goes out. I might install it if someone shares the link, but I'd stop opening it after a week because the group already pings me.
objection: Half our real updates, like a test moved or a class cancelled, only get said in WhatsApp or by a professor in class, so I don't trust an app pulling from official college stuff to catch everything. If it misses even one thing I'm back to the group anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If my whole class group, including the CR, started using it and stuff showed up there first and more accurately than on WhatsApp.
